channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: K Fresh Foods, A ‘Community-Centered’ Grocery Store, Coming To Auburn Gresham
item.description: The $4 million development will bring nutritious food to the community at a low price, leaders said. The store will be minutes away from the recently reopened Save A Lot grocery store.

item.title: ‘Women Who Built Chicago’ Bus Tour Highlights History Of City’s Trailblazers
item.description: Urban historian Shermann “Dilla” Thomas teamed up with Ancestry on the March tour honoring women whose contributions to Chicago — and the world — are often overlooked.

item.title: ASPIRA To Close Business Finance And Early College High Schools By Next Month
item.description: ASPIRA CEO Edgar Lopez said high schools will close by April 3, when all staff at the two campuses “are anticipated” to be laid off.

item.title: ‘Keep Hope Alive’: Mourners, Including 3 Presidents, Gather To Say Goodbye To Rev. Jesse Jackson
item.description: Thousands packed into the House of Hope to celebrate the life of the civil rights icon who passed away Feb. 17. A private homegoing service is scheduled Saturday morning.

item.title: Et Chi Brings Turkish Fusion To Lincoln Square, Goosefoot Finds A New Home And More Food News
item.description: Taquizas Valdez in Irving Park and L.D. Pho in Albany Park had sudden closures. And Lincoln Square has a new liquor/convenience store.

item.title: As Morgan Shoal Overhaul Plan Moves Forward, Neighbors Can Still Weigh In On Army Corps Plans
item.description: March 27 is the deadline for feedback on the Army Corps of Engineers' environmental review of a lakefront redesign near Kenwood's Morgan Shoal.

item.title: ‘Songs In The Key Of She’ Music Series Brings International Female Acts To Chicago
item.description: Spanish singer-songwriter LauraB will play in Chicago on Saturday as a part of Torito Artists' yearlong music series Songs in the Key of She.

item.title: WATCH: Rev. Jesse Jackson’s People’s Celebration In Chicago
item.description: The People’s Celebration is expected to be the largest gathering honoring Jackson, who died Feb. 17 at the age of 84.

item.title: Portage Park Bike Network Plan Sees Strong Support At Packed Neighborhood Meeting
item.description: Ald. Nicholas Sposato said it was good to see so many people show up to the Thursday meeting, and the majority of people he heard from there supported the proposed bike lane network.

item.title: PHOTOS: Rev. Jesse Jackson’s Family Praise Civil Rights Leader At Funeral Service: ‘He Opened Doors’
item.description: A final funeral service for the late Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr. was held Saturday at the Rainbow PUSH Coalition headquarters, where the icon's family told stories of his leadership and legacy.
